entities.summary: Sophie Heidi Kam (b. 1968, Ouagadougou) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ouagadougou and Burkina Faso. Known in the fields of burkina faso, poets & playwrights, africa.
